decision: User-selected Terra High routine review after the quality/cost comparison; Astra medium for targeted escalation.

disputes.route: Targeted fresh original-source reading; unresolved source/grain questions remain deferred for editorial or historian review.

proposal.status: Lowest observed proposal cost at equal text-only yield; historical proposal accuracy unmeasured

quality_reference: Two blinded model source readers, with one inconsistent case excluded uniformly from decisive comparisons; raw labels preserved.
required_before_integration: Independent semantic acceptance of every retained facet/relation
Resolve or defer consequential source disputes
Single integrator; isolated validation and affected tests

review.independence: Separate extraction and review executions; blinded assessment remains within one model family.

selected_interim_route: Terra-low extraction plus separate Terra-high admission review; Astra-medium targeted disputes
selection_status: User-selected operational route; historical sweep metrics remain unchanged and model judgments are provisional.

pilot.confirmation_source: Disjoint subset of previous benchmark, selected before calls
pilot.selection: Three review settings on identical saved Terra-low extractions; cheapest qualifying diagnostic candidate compared against saved B review.
pilot.evaluation_scope: Review-stage change with cached upstream artifacts; acquisition/extraction were not rerun.
pilot.comparison_interpretation: Confirmation compares combined prompt and reviewer-model change against the cached old-prompt baseline; it does not isolate a pure model effect.

quality_sweep.exclusion_reason: Reference duplicate decisions contradicted source-supported extension judgments. The existing event policy supports dated spread, but model readers applied it inconsistently. Excluded for every setting; raw judgments preserved.

alternatives.astra_low: Same useful-record count and clean repeats; slightly less supported claim coverage in initial sample.
alternatives.terra_high: 25 useful records, one missed supported admission; lower measured cost.
alternatives.sol_medium: 25 useful records, one missed supported admission; no measured quality advantage over Terra-high in this sample.

limitations: Selection uses a post hoc 39-case subset after a grader-consistency defect; not an untouched confirmation.
Two same-family model readers are not independent historical truth.
One phase handoff reached 13 concurrent calls; timings reflect actual load.
Eight extra Terra-medium repeat outputs were unjudged and enter cost accounting only.

orchestrator.scope: Delegate bounded work to Terra High workers and independent reviewers in isolated worktrees; coordinate reviewed handoff to main integrator.

workers.isolation: Separate codex/ worktree per concurrent writing lane; read-only independent review in assigned snapshot.
workers.integration: One coordinating chat integrates reviewed commits to main.
